summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for healthcare licensure program capacity. The strongest reference anchors are Grand Canyon Education and Covista, while the underfollowed lane contains American Public Education and HealthStream. The node appears investable through asset owners and service/platform operators that expand nursing, healthcare, social-work, counseling, and clinical-workforce training capacity. Simulation/VR hardware vendors remain mostly private or not clearly pure-play public, so the best public-market mapping in this pass is education operators plus healthcare workforce-learning software.
